trickyParts: The browser harness is not in the image and does not survive a pod replacement. It is rebuilt by /legion/scratch/harness/setup.sh, whose text is recorded verbatim in comment 6a00901c-b262-4c0e-946f-3ad9ab38bd54 on dispatch://INFRA-728 together with env.sh. Source env.sh around harness commands only, never leave it on the working shell.

Harness facts for the next role: Postgres 17 with pgvector at 127.0.0.1:55432, data under /legion/scratch/harness/pgdata, started by the implementer and never to be stopped by anyone else. PATH gains /legion/scratch/harness/root/usr/lib/postgresql/17/bin; LD_LIBRARY_PATH gains /legion/scratch/harness/root/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu and .../postgresql/17/lib. DATABASE_URL is postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/dispatch_${LEGION_ROLE}_e2e?sslmode=disable, so each role gets its own database from LEGION_ROLE. e2e/run.ts chooses every harness port itself, so two roles no longer meet on one.

@legion/contracts must be built before any browser run, or e2e/agents.ts fails with 'Cannot find module @legion/contracts/dist/index.js'. setup.sh now runs 'bun run build' in packages/contracts for that reason.

bun install rewrites bun.lock in this workspace (three workspace package versions that main's lockfile has not caught up with). It is restored from the parent commit before every commit; it is not part of this change.

Rebuild the SPA (bun run build:web) after every web/src change, including each negative control's mutation and its restore: the rows serve web/dist, so an unrebuilt dist silently tests the previous head and reports the wrong answer for a control.
deviations: The plan moves the no-diagram past-version row into e2e/doc.e2e.ts. The architect changed that to e2e/deep-links.e2e.ts (09:04Z), which is in the webkit and firefox testMatch, so the row keeps all four projects and plan departure 2 (the coverage loss) is void.

The plan has task 1 export every moved symbol. workerChunk, workerHeldPath and holdingListener have no caller outside holdWorkerSource, so they stay module-private in e2e/mermaid-helpers.ts; exporting them would be API surface nothing imports.

A2 control 3's injection is a dip that returns, not the plan's scroll-to-half-and-stay. With the plan's injection the row fails on its own toBeInViewport assertion whichever scroll rule is in place, so it does not isolate the rule; the dip-and-return leaves the end state correct, and under it the new rule fails while the old exact-zero filter passes.

MAX_SCROLL_FALL_PX is 64 against a measured maximum of 0 px. The plan asked for the constant to sit above the largest legitimate adjustment with room and at least five times below the fault; 0 px of legitimate fall makes any positive bound satisfy that, and 64 px (about two lines of text) leaves room for an engine-specific anchor nudge that 80 runs did not show while staying fifteen times below the 973 px fault.
discoveredComplexity: The plan said no changelog fragment is needed because neither package has a .changes directory; that still holds (only packages/envoy has one).

block-references.e2e.ts carried a file comment stating that each of its helpers lives in that file, so a run at the base copies one file. Moving blockId out made it false, so it now names editor.ts as the second file.
